privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Eventora is designed to keep your events and your guests' details private.

storage.title: Stored on your phone
storage.body: Events, guests, budgets, files and images are stored only on this device, in the app's private storage. There is no Eventora server.

account.title: No account
account.body: No sign-up, no login. Nothing about you is collected to use the app.

guests.title: Your guests' data
guests.body: Names, contact details and dietary preferences you enter stay on this phone. They're never sent to advertisers or analytics and never appear in notifications.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.body: Eventora does not request access to your address book. Guests are added by hand or from a CSV file you choose.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.body: Invitations, lists and reports leave the app only when you share them through Android's share menu. Eventora warns you before sharing lists with personal data.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Reminders are scheduled on your phone. They don't include guest names, contacts or amounts.

ads.title: Ads (free version)
ads.body: The free version shows a banner on browsing screens only (never on guest, invitation or seating screens). Google AdMob may process device identifiers according to your consent choices. No guest data is ever shared.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: Off by default. If you opt in, only anonymous usage events are counted — never names, contacts, amounts or texts.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.body: Subscriptions are handled by Google Play. Eventora only receives whether Premium is active.

rights.title: Your control
rights.body: Export a full backup or delete all data at any time in Settings → Backup & data. Uninstalling the app also removes everything.

privacy.analyticsHint: Helps improve Eventora. No personal data.

data.localTitle: Your data is on this phone
data.localBody: Back it up regularly, for example before changing phones. Images and documents are not included in the backup file.
data.backupBody: Creates a JSON file with all your events, guests, budgets and settings, to save where you want.
data.restoreBody: All current events will be replaced by the content of the backup.

data.deleteBody: Everything will be permanently erased from this phone. Export a backup first if you want to keep it.
